integrity: Self-contained proof and exact-arithmetic replay are provided. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification applies to completed even-order Taylor heat maps on unweighted simple joins K_k vee H under n >= beta_p(k+Delta). The degree condition is sufficient and need not be necessary. It makes no statement about intermediate stages, weighted edges, or other graphs. Publication-priority uncertainty remains.
title: A sharp even-order Taylor positivity window for sparse-core clique joins
